audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill for rows 0-5 while the content layer and packet chart both hand rows 3-6 to Xerath. Rows 3, 4 and 5 rendered two different answers.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame reaches 950 against Arcanopulse's 750, so she genuinely wins the level 1-3 Q war. From Levels 4-5 onward Eye of Destruction (1000) and Shocking Orb (1050) both outreach her, and Rite of the Arcane fires from 5000.

audit.why: Rite of the Arcane is 130/115/100 seconds and fires from 5000 range; the Levels 4-5 row is about his W and E outreaching her, not about his ult.
audit.corrected: Row 3 why now states the 1000/1050 range gap; row 4 states the 5000 range and 130s cooldown; row 5 states what his first item converts that range into.

audit.whatIsWrong: No ability interaction was stated; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); wants.foe[1] used the fabricated ability name 'Mage Chains'.
audit.why: Xerath's E is Shocking Orb, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s at 1050 range, and it is his only CC — the whole matchup is gated on that one cooldown. Arcanopulse costs 80 mana at rank 1, which is what punishes him for spamming. Rite of the Arcane immobilizes him for its duration, so he cannot walk out of your 675 tether leash while it fires.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries 13s/11s Shocking Orb, 9s/80-mana Arcanopulse and the 130s ult; wants.foe[1] renamed to Shocking Orb.

audit.why: Shocking Orb's 13 seconds at rank 1 is the entire step-up window.
